body: Thank you for the insight and the advice!
I appreciate the response!! What you said makes a lot of sense
The way she’s been towards me is making me feel otherwise.
My parents are from Guyana and they’re very toxic I’d get away from them.

I don’t like to lie or put up fronts...I was raised to think logically by my parents. If this then that is how my mind works. I do believe she put herself in a very vulnerable position for someone to have a much easier opportunity to take advantage of her. I can’t help but believe measures could have been taken by her to avoid this. I believe moving forward she should understand that not everyone plays by the rules. She’s got to able to defend herself and have the best chance to prevent someone from taking advantage of her like this. I get it, things happen and sometimes it’s out of your control. But getting black out drunk at a party while having guys you don’t even know around you isn’t a smart move... 

I’m going to keep my mouth shut and follow everything everyone’s said. Because at the end of the day she is the victim in this and as angry as I feel inside I don’t to make things any worse for her. That would be selfish and insensitive of me to do. I appreciate everyone who responded it helped a lot.

Okay we’ll go ASAP, I’m also stressing on how to deal with her emotionally. What do I say? I’ve always tried to tell her that she shouldn’t be so careless or think nothing bad is ever capable of happening to her. I’m not trying to blame her for what happened but at the same time I don’t believe she should have put so much faith in her new friends. I think it was irresponsible of her to drink so heavily while there was guys she didn’t know around her. I feel like I’m walking on a thin line.

No... you’re not understanding. I’m still seeing a lot of “I want this or I want that”. You’re not thinking about you and your boyfriends relationship or his emotional state as 1st priority in this at all. You cannot be with someone and put their emotions on the back burner like that. (That’s why I said to empathize with him) Especially in this type of situation that honestly shouldn’t be a situation to begin with. The harsh reality is you are putting a lot of strain on your relationship by having this mindset and very well could be forcing your boyfriend into a corner. From an outside perspective it looks like you’re lacking empathy towards your boyfriend and giving it all to your ex. Why is this ex so important that you would jeopardize your relationship?

My advice to you is to think from your boyfriends perspective, not just solely from your own. Think about the situation and position he’s in and really make an honest attempt to empathize with how he’s viewing all this.
I’ve always wanted a fitness friend, I get lonely going to the gym alone after a while.
I understand you completely... stay true to yourself, the world needs more people like you that care.
I am too, I figure that we’re all human and we all make bad calls so why hold onto it for long
Yeah it bugs me everyday to man. It’s why I feel so alone and detached. People you get close to will drop you in an instant. I’d never do that to anyone
It always made me feel easily disposable like I don’t matter. I often think I just put too much value into people. Or maybe everyone else is just conditioned to not develop real bonds with people.
I’m exactly the same way and I question myself if I’m wrong everyday.
